environment.hardware: Local x86_64 Linux; one job; canonical job receipt records bwrap network isolation, 1800s wall, 12GiB address-space and 8GiB normal RSS caps.

mathematics.assertion_tested: Reuse S1 primary/control counts and digest equality, exact atom/quarter arithmetic, all 3^8 accepted/encoded subset configurations, and rejection of geometric availability from equal marginals.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Sage ZZ and QQ through the standard .sage preparser
mathematics.conventions: Theorem and finite control are separate; empirical rational comparisons do not assert a population lower bound.
non_claims: No unconditional positive source acceptance bound
No IID, F04-to-KeyGen identification or geometric cap law
No rerun of historical KeyGen measurements

randomness.generator: none; existing deterministic public synthetic-seed observations reused

checks: Pinned inputs unchanged before and after
Exact rejection/success accounting for both recorded runs
Primary/control ratios strictly between1/4 and1/2, empirical only
Positive atomic mass; quarter requires2^254 seeds
Every tested encoded subset has mass at most whole-call event; conditional factorization when acceptance positive
Two couplings with identical attempt marginals refute a marginal-only geometric formula
result: implementation and finite assertion verified in the stated range; population bound remains open
residual_risks: Version1 supplemental manifest has legacy provenance limits; canonical job receipts additionally record actual argv/source hashes and resource caps.
Input digests and native observations are not Lean execution derivations.
